mentions.note: died 4th December (1974) aged 74 at his home in East London; joined 1925; First Class A.A.A. Standard over the old Two Miles Championship; Middlesex County vest; held Club Record for the five mile course; inspector in the Electrical Industry

share.d: Joe Scamell, Senr in The Belgravian, the Belgrave Harriers club gazette, 1975: 1 mention in 1 issue and 1 race result.
